newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar gets Total shareholder okay.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar gets Total shareholder okay.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said Tuesday that shareholders of Total Petroleum (North America) Ltd had approved the acquisition of the company at a special meeting in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.
Additionally, the companies said in a joint statement that Ultramar is working to provide the Federal Trade Commission with added information that the FTC had asked for last week.

The two petroleum refining and marketing companies announced in April a definitive pact for Ultramar to acquire Total in a deal valued at $811 million, including the assumption of $414 million of Total Petroleum debt.
The deal converts each outstanding Total Petroleum share into 0.322 per share of Ultramar common stock.
Completion remains subject to government approvals in Canada and the U.S.
